blocks.tamil_translation: Abbas (RA), "O Abbas! O my uncle! Shall I not give you a gift? Shall I not give you a present? Shall I not give you a reward?" Shall I not tell you of a deed that will earn you ten benefits? If you do it, Allah will forgive all your sins — the first and the last, the old and the new, those done knowingly and those done unknowingly, the small and the great, those done secretly and those done openly. That deed is:- that you pray four rak'ahs (Salat-ut-Tasbih)! In every rak'ah recite Surah Al-Fatihah along with another surah. In the first rak'ah, when you have finished the recitation, before making ruku', recite (سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ وَلَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ) 15 times. Then make ruku' and in it too recite these words 10 times. Then rise from ruku' and recite them 10 times in the standing position. Then make sajdah. In the sajdah too recite these words 10 times. Rise from the sajdah and sit, and recite them 10 times; then 10 times in the second sajdah; and 10 times in the sitting position after rising from the second sajdah. Pray all four rak'ahs in this way. In this manner, recite these words seventy-five times in each rak'ah. (O my uncle!) If you are able, pray this Salah once every day; if you are unable to pray it every day, pray it every Jumu'ah. If you are unable to do even that, pray it once a month; if you are unable to do even that, pray it once a year. If you are unable to do even that, pray it at least once in your lifetime."

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: وَجَّهَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ جَعْفَرَبْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ﵁ إِلَي بِلَادِ الْحَبَشَةِ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ إِعْتَنَقَهُ، وَقَبَّلَ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَلَا أَهَبُ لَكَ، أَلَا أُبَشِّرُكَ، أَلَا أَمْنَحُكَ، أَلَا أُتْحِفُكَ؟ قَالَ:
